journey.name: M3 create post, view, delete and edit profile
journey.description: End-to-end check of M3 against the local Docker backend, signed in as an existing user. Needs at least one photo in the device gallery.

actions.action: Verify that the main app is shown with "Home", "Explore", "Create", "Activity" and "Profile" navigation items
Verify that a "Choose photo" button is shown
Tap the first photo in the photo picker
Verify that the selected photo preview and a "Write a caption…" field are shown
Enter "First journey post" in the "Write a caption…" field
Verify that the profile is shown with "1" post
Tap the first photo in the profile grid
Verify that the post screen shows the caption "First journey post"
Verify that the profile shows "No posts yet"
Enter "Hello from the journey" in the "Bio" field
Verify that the profile shows the bio "Hello from the journey"
